## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      5 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 14 мар. 2026 г. - 10 окт. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Treus626_, 10 окт. 2026 г., 1/5: "I am frustrated because I just signed up on this app a few days ago. So far I have only signed up for two classes. The first class I went to, the studio wasn’t even open. I had waited a while, but it was not opened even past the class time. The second one I signed up for was an 8 AM barre class at a gym. I arrive just to find out that the class actually doesn’t start sometime until after 9 AM. I was speaking with a staff member at the gym who told me that he has spoken with few people who were using Class Pass who have experienced the same issue before."
            2. _Lucía Loreto_, 6 окт. 2026 г., 1/5: "I had to contact them 3 times to freeze my account and yet they failed. I’m injured and can’t use the credits. They keep me on hold and don’t end up doing their job"
            3. _mattallsop_, 17 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "I have reported the issue to my bank. This app should be reviewed by Apple for breach of app store rules on billing."
<!--/ir-theme-->
